title: Skew-supermodular colouring with two class sizes

statement.text: Let <math>p_1</math> and <math>p_2</math> be integer [[Supermodular function|skew-supermodular]] set functions on ground set ''S'' such that <math>\max\{p_1(X),p_2(X)\}\leq \min\{|X|,k\}</math> for every <math>X \subseteq S</math>, and let <math>m_1,m_2,n_1,n_2</math> be positive integers such that <math>m_1 n_1+m_2 n_2=|S|</math>. Can we decide in polynomial time if there is a partition <math>{\mathcal P}</math> of ''S'' with <math>m_1</math> classes of size <math>n_1</math> and <math>m_2</math> classes of size <math>n_2</math>, such that <math>|\{Y \in {\mathcal P}: Y \cap X \neq \emptyset\}| \geq \max\{p_1(X), p_2(X)\}</math> for every <math>X \subseteq S</math>?

status_observation.evidence: pinned EGRES Open MediaWiki revision and categories
